summary.value: Free weapon attack with a dagger, brawling weapon, or thrown weapon.

system.description: Free weapon attack with a dagger, brawling weapon, or thrown weapon. Spend MP (up to SL × 5) for a bonus on the Accuracy Check equal to MP spent ÷ 5. If your result beats the target's Defense by 5 or more, the damage ignores all Affinities and is multiplied × (1 + SL ÷ 5, rounded down, max ×3).
